description:
List the account's currently live stories.

Stories expire 24 hours after posting, so this returns only what is live right now. Story insights come from instagram_get_media_insights with media_product_type="STORY".

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_list_stories
title: List Active Stories
